nodes.en: 1. In this chapter we implemented a matrix multiplication kernel that has each thread produce one output matrix element. In this question, you will implement different matrix-matrix multiplication kernels and compare them.【M1】
nodes.zh: 1. 在本章中，我们实现了一个矩阵乘法核函数，其中每个线程生成一个输出矩阵元素。在本问题中，你将实现不同的矩阵-矩阵乘法核函数并对它们进行比较。【M1】

nodes.en: a. Write a kernel that has each thread produce one output matrix row. Fill in the execution configuration parameters for the design.
nodes.zh: a. 编写一个核函数，使每个线程生成一个输出矩阵行。为该设计填写执行配置参数。

nodes.en: b. Write a kernel that has each thread produce one output matrix column. Fill in the execution configuration parameters for the design.
nodes.zh: b. 编写一个核函数，使每个线程生成一个输出矩阵列。为该设计填写执行配置参数。

nodes.en: c. Analyze the pros and cons of each of the two kernel designs.
nodes.zh: c. 分析这两种核函数设计的优缺点。

nodes.en: 2. A matrix-vector multiplication takes an input matrix B and a vector C and produces one output vector A. Each element of the output vector A is the dot product of one row of the input matrix B and C, that is, A[i]=∑【1】j【/1】 B[i][j]+C[j]. For simplicity we will handle only square matrices whose elements are single-precision floating-point numbers. Write a matrix-vector multiplication kernel and the host stub function that can be called with four parameters: pointer to the output matrix, pointer to the input matrix, pointer to the input vector, and the number of elements in each dimension. Use one thread to calculate an output vector element.
nodes.zh: 2. 矩阵-向量乘法以一个输入矩阵 B 和一个向量 C 为输入，产生一个输出向量 A。输出向量 A 的每个元素是输入矩阵 B 的一行与 C 的点积，即 A[i]=∑【1】j【/1】 B[i][j]+C[j]。为简单起见，我们只处理元素为单精度浮点数的方阵。编写一个矩阵-向量乘法核函数，以及可以用四个参数调用的主机桩函数：指向输出矩阵的指针、指向输入矩阵的指针、指向输入向量的指针，以及每个维度中的元素个数。使用一个线程来计算一个输出向量元素。

nodes.en: 【1】【2】2【/2】【/1】We will refer to the dimensions of multidimensional data in descending order: the z dimension followed by the y dimension, and so on. For example, for a picture of n pixels in the vertical or y dimension and m pixels in the horizontal or x dimension, we will refer to it as a n × m picture. This follows the C multidimensional array indexing convention. For example, we can refer to P[y][x] as P【3】y,x【/3】 in text and figures for conciseness. Unfortunately, this ordering is opposite to the order in which data dimensions are ordered in the gridDim and blockDim dimensions. The discrepancy can be especially confusing when we define the dimensions of a thread grid on the basis of a multidimensional array that is to be processed by its threads.
nodes.zh: 【1】【2】2【/2】【/1】我们将按降序引用多维数据的维度：先是 z 维度，然后是 y 维度，依此类推。例如，对于一幅在垂直（y）维度上有 n 个像素、在水平（x）维度上有 m 个像素的图像，我们将其称为 n × m 图像。这符合 C 语言多维数组的索引约定。例如，为了简洁，我们可以在正文和图示中将 P[y][x] 记为 P【3】y,x【/3】。遗憾的是，这种顺序与 gridDim 和 blockDim 维度中数据维度的排列顺序相反。当我们基于一个要由其线程处理的多维数组来定义线程网格的维度时，这种差异尤其容易令人困惑。
